dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two again. I was just sorting out my teapot.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: After you helped clean my teapot last time, I thought to myself, I really ought to give it a proper deep clean.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: It would make things so much easier when I wish to treat my guests to tea in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: So I took it down to the Bishui River and gave it a good old wash, inside and out. But it was no use. This teapot is so dreadfully difficult to clean.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Youngsters, would you help an old lady clean her teapot once more? For old time's sake?
